snippet.title: Truth Scrapper Demo Announcement Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Truth Scrapper is a romantic mystery visual novel with a branching story, the next game from insertdisc5, award-winning developer of In Stars and Time, and you can PLAY THE DEMO RIGHT NOW ON STEAM? HUH? WHAT?? WOW! Sounds like you should check it out, and watch our all-new trailer too! When memories are more precious than gold, what - and who - will you choose to remember as you set out to investigate a series of attacks in a remote town?

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239830/Truth_Scrapper/
